notes.title: Birthday Patch. OP is turning 1!
notes.notes:
It's been a full year since the full launch of Obsidian Prince and it's been amazing to see people play and enjoy our creation. 

We're so incredibly thankful to you, our wonderful community for the support with feedback, spreading the word, and generally cheering us on while we were working on getting the game out to the world. 

As a small thank you we've put together a birthday patch for you to enjoy. 

[b]Here are the patch notes. [/b]

[list]
[*] A new quest has been added to celebrate our birthday together with the community that made it possible. (Look for the guy with the birthday cake near the graveyard).  
[*] A new artifact (It's a surprise!) 
[*] A potion of invulnerability has been added. Perfect for those "I've painted myself into a corner moments" 
[*] The alchemist now has some new items in stock. They have also learned to turn steel into Glod 😮 
[*] Fixed a bug where the Staff Maker couldn't be upgraded properly
[*] Fixed a number of spelling mistakes (Potentially added more, let us know)
[/list]

Happy Birthday! :) 

-Sigrid & Mattias

notes.title: Obsidian Prince updated with Steam Deck aspect ratio fix.
notes.notes:
Obsidian Prince is now properly playable on Steam Deck! No more issues with the UI getting cut off in certain views. 
At the same time we've fixed a number of issues with aspect ratios for 21:9 as well as of course 16:10.

A new unique Shield and a new Artifact can now be found while exploring Emalon. 

A new quest is available. Help a sad little green guy return joy to the world. 

A new treasure dungeon has been added. 

Fixed and issue where the Masterworks Brigandine Armor didn't reduce damage correctly.

Fixed and issue where the Notepad & Pen and Mask of Sadness didn't increase ability damage by enough.

Various spelling mistakes have been corrected.

notes.title: Bug fixes 9/20/2022
notes.notes:
A smaller patch to fix some rare, but nasty bugs we've had reported by our awesome community. (That's you guys!)

Fixed a bug where you were not able get a backstory card from the altar if you had exactly 50g. 

Fixed multiple rare cases where certain rooms would cause the game to softlock if the player didn't have anywhere to move. 

Fixed a number of spelling mistakes and corrected an old reference to Endless Mode to the current name Roguelike Mode.

notes.title: New Area to Explore, New Wandering Monsters, New Quick House Access QoL feature.
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

We've been hard at work on this patch trying to balance new content, bug fixes and quality of life features. 

We hope you'll enjoy what we have added and as always look forward to your continued feedback! :) 

Mattias & Sigrid

[b]A completely new area to explore, including new quests to solve.[/b]

Once you have unlocked the adventurers guild, look to the south near the fisherman's house where a ghost requires your help. 


[b]Shortcuts to merchants and other key buildings.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38340650/5534e4e583a1537734b1ce3aa467c0c96cfe74ef.png[/img]

We've added a menu that allows you to quickly navigate to all important houses in-game. Once you've built or discovered a specific house, you'll be able to click it directly in the list to access it. 

You'll find the button for the Housing Shortcuts at the top right of the screen. It looks like a tiny house! 

[b]Four more wandering monster encounters.[/b]

Multiple new monster encounters have been added to make visits to the Emalon even more interesting. 

[b]Multiple smaller bug fixes.[/b]

Everything from smaller stability fixes to spelling errors.

notes.title: Obsidian Prince is leaving Early Access!
notes.notes:
[h3]The last chapter is complete and the final boss awaits![/h3]
It's been a year since we entered Early Access, having only the first chapter of the Campaign. We're thrilled to announce that Obsidian Prince is finally complete, the last pieces are in and the game is ready to be conquered from start to finish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38340650/f5dde19c15de3b23134595162037db27231d74d6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38340650/5d4d5439e1e3cf730361abbaf6433386c2c12891.png[/img]

[h3]Whats new?[/h3]

Now that we're entering 1.0 there are several new things. First of all, there is a whole new chapter with dungeons, quests and all the trappings. There are also all of the new classes, buildings, items and quality of life features. But most of all, the final boss level!

A lot has happened since we first went into Early access and we owe a lot of thanks to the many testers and fans for keeping us on our toes during that time, we love you [i]and[/i] your pesky bugs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38340650/8e01187de96842d104d295901995912c53467232.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38340650/58e4afb824e1ef4c2ff931515bba366217c5a4ec.png[/img]

[h3]And it's 20% off![/h3]

We're going to be on sale for 20% off this week. If you've been waiting for a reason to get on board and delve into Obsidian Prince now is the best time to do it. If you're looking for a new class to try, i'd recommend the Shroom Herder. Currently the highest score is held by a Shroom Herder. It's quite a unique class, 10/10 highly recommend.

Without spoiling too much, there is also a quirky twist at the end of the game when you meet the final boss. The mysterious Obsidian Prince may surprise you. I'll say no more. (it's great, you'll love it!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38340650/6528e2c444f96751266bbc804b8471b58ed607e6.png[/img]

[h3]Come say Hi![/h3]

Remember to jump onto our discord channel and say hello! We're always happy to see new faces. The devs aren't shy either, they'll happily have a chat :)

[url=https://discord.com/invite/ZmSzhmC]click here for Discord![/url]

Now go forth! conquer the Obsidian Prince!

notes.title: The Ice Patch!
notes.notes:
Patch notes:

Water
Water can now freeze! If you punch someone standing on ice, they are stunned.

New Weapon: Icicle
Stab all opponents in a line with a large icicle, freezing any water they're standing in. Enemies that take damage are immobilized. Additionally, anyone who takes damage while standing on ice, is stunned.

Inspirations:
First Snow - [On Use] Stun anyone standing on ice.
Iceshard - [On Use] Guaranteed Icicle critical hit. (Very useful with the agility tree, and the capes...)
Glacial Glide - [On Use] Slide on the ice created by the icicle.

Indicator
Well, you've been able to see this previewed on the discord - you can now see information about tiles!
Introduced in this patch, you will see an indicator following the mouse. The indicator will display information about the tile it's on in the bottom left corner.
It will eventually be expanded to also include enemy casting information - so you'll be able to see more clearly who is casting what, where.

Other:
Various minor balance fixes
Made sure the moneybag isnt visible on top of the Inventory while shopping in a dungeon.
Spelling fixes!
Lots and lots and lots of minor fixes. (Especially regarding wording on the Rapier, thanks everyone!)

And as per usual, lots of work done on Chapter 3.

notes.title: Ranger Patch!
notes.notes:
Well, the Ranger is one of the oldest classes by now, and has been in need of an upgrade for a while!

Ranger changes:

Removed Inspiration Cards:
Removed backstory card "Pacify", and "Agile". They still remains on the Bee's Master.

New Inspiration cards:
Fearsome Predator - If you kill someone that has Hunters Mark applied to them, everyone with Hunters mark takes 30% base damage.
Rangers Strike - Apply Hunters Mark to target before doing a move attack, and then take a step backwards from the target. Rangers Strike counts as agile for backstory deck quest purposes.

The idea is that you'll want to build up a lot of Hunter's Mark on your enemies, and then explode them all at the same time. Also, Rangers Strike helps with survivability early game, as agile now also increases the Rangers damage output (by a lot!)

Try the new Ranger out and see how it feels!

New Skilltree:
Affliction - Whiddle them down, piece by piece. Affliction specializes in combining status effects with dots.
	Poisoned Slice - On Base / Move attack, it will poison your enemy for (3, 6, 9) damage over 3 turns.
	Torment - When an enemy takes damage, it will gain the Afflicted status effect. Afflicted Do 1 damage per statuseffect on an enemy per statuseffect, not counting afflicted.
	Callousness - 5% chance to gain 1 armor when damaging an enemy affliced with a status effect. Does not trigger on enemies that are minions.
	Malodour - Gain 3x Malodour Inspirations - On kill, apply a poison which does 10% of your base attack over 3 turns, to everyone near your target. Does not work on minions.
	Poisoned Slice 
	Calamity - On Base / Move attack, spread Afflicted to any enemy adjacent to your target, if it is Afflicted.
	Poisoned Slice 
	Bleed them down - On base attack / move attack, every enemy takes 1 damage per status effect

Affliction pairs super well with certain classes and weapon setups. We'll let you guys figure out which ones!


Bugfixes and Changes:
	The "Roguelike Mode" button has merged with the continue button. If you click it, and you have a save, you automatically enter your previous save.
	This means that you can't accidentally wipe out the progress of a run.
	Fixed a bug where the armor shop didn't have a coin on it.
	Fixed a bug where the hospital could accidentally leave a card on screen.
	Mirror text change to correctly show that the ghosts last for 1 attack.
	Fixed a bug where you could have the sword icon up when trying to loot.
	Fixed a bug where the minimap was sometimes click through.
	The teleportation elite now has an updated teleportation target effect. Look for purple light.
	Various minor fixes.
	Oh, and we've made the zombie's holiday hat only appear during the month of December!

notes.title: The Obsidian Prince Yuletide Patch. Grab a fork and get comfortable
notes.notes:
During the holiday season we usually enjoy good food with friends and family. This year we of course need to include our lovely Obsidian Prince community in the celebrations. So before we leave on vacation here's the last patch of 2021 and it's food themed! 🙂

[h2]The restaurant has opened[/h2]
Well not quite, the chef will need a bit of help getting it up and running. You can find him near the city center looking for brave adventurers to help him with a tiny task... 

[h2]A lovely dungeon picnic[/h2]
Adventurers can now eat before entering the dungeon. Make sure they bring some of the awesome food you can buy from the restaurant. 

[h2]New tasty dishes[/h2]
You can now add Torturelini and Spicy Taco to your Yuletide table.
(these will also drop in Roguelike Mode... if you're lucky)

[h2]Zombie's are getting in the holiday spirit[/h2]
Brrrreead puuuuudding...

[h2]Minor bugfixes and other polish[/h2]
Thank you for reporting issues to us and helping us continously improve the game. 🙂

Finally Mattias and I wanted to thank all of you guys who have played, wishlisted, provided feedback, shared Obsidian Prince with friends or otherwise supported us during the past year. 

We really appreciate you all and wish you a very happy holiday season and a fantastic entry into the new year. 

-Sigrid and Mattias

notes.title: The Shroomherder Patch!
notes.notes:
Patch notes:

NEW PRESTIGE CLASS - Shroomherder

The Shroomherder spawns mushrooms and relies on having them fight as her front line, while masterfully teleporting out of distance. It comes with 5 new backstory cards! Some of them also apply to druids. It is available in Roguelike mode for testing, and will be made ready for the campaign before or during the release of Chapter 3.

The Shroomherder replaces the "Mushroom" spell originally found on the Mold Druid with the "Shroomherder" spell. It spawns a mushroom and has it walk around as a pet, until it explodes or otherwise expires.

New backstory cards:
Armored Chantarelle: Gain 2 armor when a big shroom guy perishes.
Stray Shroom: On mycelin portal, spawn a mini-mushroom pet where you used to be.
Infected Mushroom: On base or move attack, infect an enemy. On its death, spawn a mini-mushroom pet.

New backstory cards shared with Mold Druid:
Fire Druid: On mushroom explode, light a fire in a 3x3 area. (Bring a fire cape...)
Mushroom Samba: Mycelin Port is now instant.

Roguelike Mode adjustments:
All enemies now have 30% less health when below level 5.
All enemies now have 15% less health when below level 10.

We're hoping that this will make the Roguelike mode a little bit more accessible. This should make early game a little bit easier, and have late game punch just as hard. But, now you'll have an easier time getting your build up.

Campaign adjustments:
The tooltip will no longer go out of bounds when building buildings placed on the left side of the UI.

Belt adjustments:
Using any kind of heal potion, mana potion, or an armor kit no longer ends your turn. Happy belting!

Charge adjustments:
Charge 5 (Thrust) now gives a helpful indicator so you can see when and where it will be applied. Thrust makes it so that you can attack anyone you are moving towards.

Food: 
Some new ingredients have been added. Restaurant is coming...

Other bugs:
Fixed a bug where Cleave did not apply its damage correctly.

As always, lots of minor bugfixes, secret game balancing, and general polish has also been applied and poked and prodded and fixed and whatnot!

notes.title: The ASCENDANCY PATCH
notes.notes:
Roguelike mode has changed: You know have an ascendancy mode. Ascendancy mode comes with 9 levels, each making the game incrementally harder. By completing the game in ascendancy mode, you unlock the next level!

Difficulty levels:

1. Vanilla - base game.
2. Never talk to strangers - Enemy numbers now scale with ascension level.
3. Cherry Picked Curses - Add 3 cursed weight cards to your inspiration deck.
4. Muscle Hustle - Enemy Health and Damage now scales with ascension level.
5. Just a flesh Wound - Replace 3 backstory cards with 3 wounds.
6. The Kakistocracy - More elites, scales with ascension level.
7. Maximized Minimalism - Bosses drop less loot.
8. Your Glod and Your Life - Expensive Shops
9. A Subtle Shift of Emphasis - Enemies leave necrotic fields which heals them, on death.

Each ascension difficulty multiplies your end score by it's number - so at Ascension 5, it's your score x5. Ascension 9 is HARD. This is the "dead souls" of difficulty. It requires an insane amount of knowledge of the game, and some luck.

Because of the shift in the Roguelike mode, we are resetting the highscore. We are also merging the highscore into the Steam's official highscore system, which means that you can only have one entry at a time, however, in the future this should become a more stable solution.

We are releasing this highscore + mode now, primarily for testing. Expect there to be fixes and adjustments!

Other changes:

Equipment drop levels have been somewhat nerfed in Ascendancy mode. Expect the same amount of drops, but for them to be slightly less powerful. 
New inspiration card - Cursed Weight. It does nothing.

Various minor bugfixes :)

Enjoy!

notes.title: Chapter 2 Release
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38340650/f60786e613dc9eb81afe5f0e32c8dce6ceebc581.png[/img]

[h2]New Classes![/h2]

[b]Grave Jester[/b]
Summon zombies and ghosts to your aid!

[b]Mold Druid (now unlockable in campaign)[/b]
Be a fun guy, spread mold and fungi.

[b]Viking - Warrior Prestige class.[/b]
Can generate glod, and charge diagonally!

[b]Bees Master - Ranger Prestige class.[/b]
A minion master that uses people dressed up as bees. Also actual bees!


[h3]What is a prestige class?[/h3]
A prestige class uses the base abilities of its regular class, with different backstories, and sometimes change skills and inspirations somewhat.


[h2]New weapons:[/h2]
Storm hammer - Blast your opponents!

Dog - Summon a trusty dog to aid you.

Shovel - Dig your way outta trouble.

Mirror - Show your enemies their bad side and create minions.


[h2]New skilltrees:[/h2]

Water - Spread water, throw sharks.

Fortification - Take damage like a champ.

(Several skilltree adjustments and balancing / improvements)


[h2]Other New Features [/h2]

New tileset: [b]The Underworld[/b]


[b]New room types[/b] - treasure room, resource room, trap rooms, event rooms


[b]Health bars![/b] It's way easier to read the view now.


Move attack Choose who you want to attack + improved tutorial clarity.
Two new bosses.


[b]Two new elites [/b]

Stormy which spreads water, and on kill, casts a lightning bolt electrocuting all the water.

Cultist Leader, who spawns cultists, who may turn into undead...


[b]New enemies![/b]

Sewers - Rat in a box. Spawns rats, jumps around, and shoots. Is also the new tutorial end boss.

Forest - Troll. Trolls have a strong self regeneration effect, and area effect attacks.

Purple Crypt - Warlock. The warlock slowly builds up area effect attacks, and heals other zombies.


Tactical mode, which has also been optimized heavily for chapter 2!


Animations and sounds! Loads of work has done into making animations and sounds way better.


Multiple new questlines to explore in the campaign.


New hero selector in roguelike mode!


Improved wounds.


More food!


Damage log available on the shield, just hover on it for a while.


Campaign training rework - easier to use, and more fun.


Tutorial update - less text, more action.


More music!


You can now escape or right click to close UI elements.


Campaign resource re-balancing (part 1)

In chapter 2, not only is there a lot of new quests, there's also a Colosseum with some extremely challenging fights to beat...


Lots and lots of minor things, quality of life changes, and tons of bug-fixes!


Enjoy! 🙂

notes.title: Just a minor patch.

notes.title: Tactical Mode Patch!
notes.notes:
Tactical Mode has been optimized, and should now be lightning fast!

Ratzooka now says "Ratillery strike" now and then!

Various bugfixes:
Inspiration cards will no longer until all Backstory cards have been picked.
Fixed a bug where a good doggie could cause some bad positioning errors.
Fixed som other positioning bugs for enemies.

You can no longer close the loot window on accident.

Other various minor fixes.

notes.title: THE PET PATCH
notes.notes:
[b]New weapon: DOG![/b]
We are introducing the first actual pet into the game, in the shape of a dog!
To get a dog, equip a Dog Collar and activate the skill.
The dog will take its turn before the player moves (after the enemies), and will randomly attack nearby enemies. The dog will disappear after it has attacked 3 times.
If you activate the dog again, it will jump to the opponent nearest to you.

It comes with 3 inspirations:
Dog Attack - The dog attacks everyone in proximity.
Fetch - Add 2 more attack to your dog before it disappears.
Pet the Dog - All enemies withing a short distance from the dog, try to move to a random position nearby the dog. 

The dog is available in the Roguelike mode right now, and will be introduced into the campaign when Chapter 2 is released! You can unlock it using Obsidian Pennies, which you get from playing the roguelike mode.

[b]Move attack[/b]
You can now choose who you move attack. There will be an orange marker close to your expected target. Hover with the mouse close to who you want to target.

[b]A higher item tier is available in Roguelike mode![/b]
We have raised the item tiers by 1 for the roguelike mode.

[b]Fire cape[/b]
Sick of taking fire damage from a tile that's on fire? Equip the Fire Cape.

[b]Gas Mask[/b]
Do you like breathing? Do you like not getting poisoned by those evil toxic gases? Equip the Gas Mask! It comes with an oxygen backpack, and so it goes on the torso slot. 

[b]Event Droprates[/b]
Expect to find Torso items more often, and potions and food less often. We realized that the trap events reward Bandage noodles a little bit too often, and so we've tuned them a bit. 

[b]Chest Drops[/b]
Chests now always drop higher tiered items.

[b]Umbrella changes[/b]
The umbrella now spreads mold in a 3x3 infront of it. It's now great with a fire build - try it on a candlemage, or anyone specced into fire!	
Take flight has been adjusted so it can't poison the player.
Minor bugfixes to increase Umbrella stability and fun.

[b]Candlemage:[/b]
Chicken and Egg now creates MORE FIRE. Really. Go try it out. Cast rolling flame and conflagarate in any order but in direct sequence to trigger it, once its slotted into your backstories.

[b]Mold Druid:[/b]
Added a minimum distance to how close an autoshroom can spawn.

[b]Viking:[/b]
Replaced starting backstory Roundabout backstory with Onward!
Replaced starting backstory Effortless Twirl with Ready or Not.

[b]Skilltree:[/b]
Increased stability on the Tactician Card.
Sacrifice now stacks, ie. if you have multiple Sacrifice cards, it will trigger multiple times.

[b]Minor changes & bugfixes:	[/b]
Bashing chests now increased the difficulty of a dungeon.
Water soaking no longer works through stealth. Bye bye über rogue builds!
Glod piles can no longer get feared or poisoned.
Glod piles no longer reward exp.
Fixed cards size on backstory pick.
Fixed cards size on inspiration pick.
Removed the jumping giraffes from start screen.
Right clicking can no longer close the starting menu...
The Tile effect on bandit should now be removed on its death.
Potion of expertise now reopen compended the attack/move projection.
Skill / backstory quests should update immediately.
Someone has more hair.
Lots and lots of minor stability and polish stuff (mouse pointer fixes, softlocks, etc)


It should be easier now than ever to get up on that Roguelike highscore now. Have fun!

notes.title: The Treasure Patch!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hooray, glod![/h2]

[b]New:[/b]

Treasure rooms!
You've started finding treasure rooms spread out across the dungeons you merrily explore! Attack the Glodpiles to get some much needed extra glod.

You can now skip card pick on levelling.

You can find the Treasure Rooms in Scout dungeons in the campaign, or here and there in the Roguelike mode.

[b]Changes & Fixes:[/b]

Tutorial Boss (Box Rat) remake:
We've been wanting to redo the "boss" at the end of the tutorial for quite some time, so now we have!

It's also added into sewers as a new minion:
We've also introduced the Box Rat into the sewers, as a regular enemy. We've been playing sewers now and then, and, well, we've found it's been a little bit harder than the other tilesets.

Hunters Mark no longer disappear when you attack it. We've also added a neat visual effect. Hunters mark has had a fix to retarget.

The Candlemages "Boom" effect no longer lights his own tile on fire.

New Icons for the Event rooms! We've replaced the neat white balls with fancy red jumping questionmarks.

There is now a small blue effect when you gain mana.

There are some additional faces for the NPCs and highscore!

We have also fixed a bunch of minor bugs and glitches, and we're aiming to nail down any remaining soft-locks as soon as possible.

notes.title: Charge Fixing patch + other fixes and changes.
notes.notes:
Charge:
Thank you so much for your help in tracking the bug where the game might get stuck on charge. 

Charge has hade a minor rework to fix this. Now, if you hit someone on the final tile of the charge, its stunned, and thrown to your own previous position. Super nice for juggling those evil teleporter elites.

We are [u]hoping [/u] that this fixes the bug, but since we haven't found a way to recreate the bug yet, it might mean that further work is necessary to resolve it. Again, thank you for helping out with this during Early Access.

Water skilltree changes:
Soak: Soak no longer removes the water you're standing on. This should now synergy harder with Storm Hammer.
Puddle Jumper: The range of Puddle jumper has been increased by 1. This makes it the biggest AOE spell ingame - and it's super fun. It's also been changed to scale with damage quests.

Cleric heal changes: We've reworked the spellcasting effects.

Violence bugfix: It turns out the buff was only applied on the turn subsequent to earning more stacks. This has been fixed.

There are also a bunch of minor fixes and changes included in this patch - some of them too small to mention, some of them so secret we can't tell our players, because they might get to the no.1 in the highscore more easily!

Currently, work is ongoing for Chapter 2. We are hoping to release it in the end of September or beginning of October, depending on how we hit our milestones. It will include a new tileset, expand the campaign, an entirely new class to play around with, the restaurant, and a bunch of other things...

notes.title: The cool dude patch.
notes.notes:
Charge is now in "safe" mode - there's a bug with charge that we're having immense issues chasing down. If the game gets stuck after a charge (this is rare), please contact us. There is a log file we will want to have a look at. Dont worry - charge bugging won't wreck your progress - go to the main menu and then continue into the game again and everything will be resolved. You may have to restart the room you're in, but that's it.

Prevented a bug where the game could fail closing a building when you escape/right click it.

Event notices in the campaign are no longer click through.

Fixed a bug where equipping an armor in the equip screen didn't display your correct health/armor values.

notes.title: The preparation patch!

The music has been revamped! Listen to the soundtrack, see whats new! 

You can now close windows using ESCAPE, or by right clicking.

We have started working on our next tileset. You will hopefully be able to play it by the end of the month! (This is huge, and has taken up most of our time this dev-cycle). Or September. Visit our discord if you're curious as to how it looks...

Sounds have been added to the altar.

Damage numbers stick around longer.

New level up sound.

Tons of minor tunings and fixes - animations, sounds - polish stuff, that might be hard to spot immediately and mostly apply to giving the game a better feel.

Bugfixes:

Fixed another issue with round strike costs.
Added extra sounds.
Scatter trap now stacks.
Charge fixes.

Portrait fix for viking on the highscore.
Various minor fixes.

notes.title: Effortless Twirling fix.
notes.notes: Effortless Twirling stacks weirdly. This has been fixed!

notes.title: Viking Prestige class released!
notes.notes:
New prestige class: VIKING!

The Viking is a prestige class for the warrior. That means it starts with the same-ish basic abilities, but with a twist. 

Right now, the Viking is only playable in Challenge Mode (with this patch, renamed into Roguelike mode). When we release chapter 2, we will make it available for the Campaign mode. You'll find it it selectable when you pick the Warrior-archetype, after clicking the portal.

The Viking has a different backstory deck and sometimes other inspiration cards, and starts with other weapons and inspirations. All of this makes it play very differently from it's base class.

For the Viking, it's charge ability works diagonally. It can spread water, has a dangerous way of stacking damage, and can easily generate glod. 

It also turns your character into a boat now and then! 

The Viking starts with a Storm Hammer and a Shield, and instead of having the Bash and Cleave inspirations, it has Lightning Rod and There and Back Again.

The Viking will cost 775, or 200 if you already have the Shield and Storm Hammer unlocked.

New Backstory cards:
Raiding Party
Increases range by 1, spread water where you travel.
[Replaces Ignition]

Mead Fueled Frenzy
Take 5 damage, gain + 1 damage.
[Replaces Violence]

Pillage
Gain 1 gold per Round Strike target.

The following backstory cards will also be available for the warrior:

Onward!
Become invulnerable after using charge.

Ready or Not
When you jump, Roundstrike where you land. This will trigger any related backstories and inspirations.

New Inspiration cards:
There and Back Again
On charge, charge back again!

Other changes and fixes:
Warrior Charge had a bug where you could end up "inside" an enemy. This has been fixed, and enemies now always get thrown away from the character landing spot.

Renamed Challenge mode to Roguelike mode.

Various minor fixes.

notes.title: Patching time! New skilltree!
notes.notes:
It's PATCHING timeeeeee!

NEW Skilltree:
	Fortification! (Think like a fort. Be the fort.)
	We've been wanting to implement another Armor tree for ages now, and we've finally taken the time to do it!
	
	Field Repair: Every time you take damage, regenerate (1, 2, 3) armor after 3 turns.	
	Leaping Fort: On Jump, gain (1, 2, 3) armor.	
	(New Inspiration!) Refute Damage: If you would take more than 5 damage, take only 5 damage.
	Armored Slam: If your armor is full, do 5 more damage.

We also been looking into some of the 8 pointers of the other skilltrees, and made a couple of changes:
	Armor Spikes - Now returns (3, 6, 9) damage instead of (1, 2, 3)
	Polish Armor (Armor) - On wait, gain as much armor as you would energy.
	Quick Charge (Battery) - On wait, double your energy gain.
	Brain Storm - Buffed to 15 damage from 10 damage.

The skilltree in general has updated texts, and should now be easier to read. We will continue to review and balance the skilltree.

We have also continued to rework abilities to give them more "oompf!"
We have now updated the animations and sounds for (including inspiration modifiers):
	Base attack
		Now does a little jump!

	Warrior Charge
		There is now a neat effect when you charge through enemies. (This is currently my favourite skill now, feels so rewarding...)

	Rapier
		Added various jumps, strikes, and BAMs.

	Chakram
		You can now see a line where the chakram bounced around.

	Candlemage Conflagarate
		There is now a huge swirling conflagaration on the skills target.

	Mold Druid Mushroom
		The mushrooms now Grow and Shrink.

	Mold Druid Mycelin Port
		You can now see the path the mold druid chose to travel!

	Lantern
		Buzzing! Sparkling! You also now more easily seen when inspirations have been applied.

	Rouge Wither Poison
		Now has a far better hiss effect to it.

	Short & Long Bow:
		A better "poof"	effect has been added to their arrows.

	Spear:
		You can now see a neat trail behind your guy as they kill their foes.

	On damage:
		Added a small animation to the player character when taking damage.

Some minor audio changes.

Bugfixes:
	We have finally found the time to fix it so that the angry remains of the berserkers are no longer visible. While doing this, we have also remade the effect to be less space consuming.	
	Various minor bug fixes have also been applied.

notes.title: Massive Tutorial update

The tutorial as been revamped from scratch, and Obsidian Prince should be far more welcoming for new players now!

Our focus for the next patch will be more content for existing players!

notes.notes: We have moved a bunch of damage text animations from out onto the world, onto the health / armor shield, and given it a bunch of extra effects. Enjoy the "oomph!". It should be even more apparent now that you need to not take damage!

notes.title: The ambient patch!
notes.notes:
This patch has a huge focus on sound ambience and visual effects.

We are going to keep working on ambience in future patches, and this is just a first step to improve things.

We've added a vignette effect + a stronger hurt effect on the player. More changes are incoming here to make the experience more visceral, and to make new players understand that taking damage is actually really bad, and you should avoid it all costs.

Updated damage animations. Slimes splat, humans cry out, rats quack... squack? Squeak? Yes, that one.
Improved all zombie, rat, human and slime sounds.
There is additional fireball mage sounds.
There is additional ligthning caster and water maiden sounds.
Additional shield guard sounds guard sounds.
Upgraded door sounds on the door minigame.

Better woosh on round strike.
There is now MORE BLOOD EVERYWHERE. A vampire could probably taste the rainbow in the sewers now...
Improved visual walk effect on all hostile forces.
There are fire effects, fire animations, improved fire sounds.
Crossbow loading sound on the Crossbowmen.
Ratzooka load / aim sound.

New features:

	You will now get a reward popup for the item from a trap. If you are wounded, it'll pop up afterwards.

Campaign:
You'll find improved hammer icons for the tier 2 and tier 3 icons.

Bugfixes:
Fixed card reward from trap - there was 25% chance of getting nothing.
The candlemage and the mold druid had their cards all mixed up for the campaign. Didnt unlock the Mold Druid yet? Soon...
Cursor fix.
Nerfed the XP the illusionist gave. No more exp bombing!
Arrows on charge hover have been fixed to the new system.
Hopefully fixed a bug where the warriors CHARGE could lock the game on the Lantern fight.
The Patience inspiration mistakenly triggered on attack instead of on wait. This has been fixed.

notes.title: Training and Recruitment Patch!
notes.notes:
Remade features:
Campaign training has been re-vamped from scratch. We've replaced the old functionality of putting people into buildings, and built an entirely new view where you can do everyone at once.

It should be easier to use, easier to understand, and bring lots of joy to the game :)

Recruit price adjustment:
The price of recruiting a new hero has been slashed.

New sounds:
We're focusing on immersion for a bit. That means more sounds, and more animations for everything. This first patch focuses on giving sounds to rats and slimes, but incoming patches (sometime next week), will have updates to heroes, enemies, skills, including animations and effects.

notes.title: New Skilltree + minor fixes!
notes.notes:
NEW SKILLTREE

When it rains, it pours. You can now get your feet (and everything else wet) by speccing into the new Water skill tree. Happy puddle jumping!

Water:
3x Water Burst - "Gain a (33, 66, 100)% chance to spread water on damage."
3x Soak - "If you are standing on water, there's a (33%, 66%, 100%) chance to absorb it at the end of your turn, giving you +1 energy."
Inspiration: Puddle Jumper "If you jump into water, spread it around your character, and do 50% base damage to everyone next to you."
Shark Shot (at 8): "If you have full energy when your turn ends, shoot a shark on a random enemy. This shark does your base damage. Lose 5 energy."

The water bursts and soaks are evenly spread through the tree.

TACTICAL MODE BETA

Press Tab to toggle an overview of what the enemies are going to do! (This is a BETA feature, and can impact performance - we will optimize the performance once we think the feature is nearing completion, we're going to add more things to it)

GENERAL IMPROVEMENTS

The sounds for a number of skills and enemies had been displaced in another dimension. We've pulled them back to our plane so among other things you'll now be able to hear sounds for: 
Bursters,
The Illusionist, 
Things that get thrown,
And most importantly explosions!

Additional Splashyness has been added to water.

Some animations and effects have been updated for:
Trap weapon
Chakram 
Spear

notes.title: Mold Druid, weapon updates, and various fixes!

Umbrella rework!

	The inspiration "Take Flight", now Jump back 2 spaces, if possible. Poison and spread mold to your original tile.

Book of Flame breath
	Coughing Flame now works without a Book of Flame-type weapon equipped.

Longbow rework (Rain of Arrows)
	Rain of arrows now shoots a regular arrow as well!
	The effect is triggered before the next player turn, after enemies move.

Damage Calculator:

notes.title: Changes! Fixes! Wow!
notes.notes:
Weapons now come with less titles. (We may possibly add Title as an actual weapon at some point in the future... maybe via some kind of Nobleman-class? We'll see. We'll miss you Title weapons!)

We've updated the Shield Guard in the Rain Fortress so it's easier to figure out for new players. We also added some more "oomph" to its rush!

Damage calculator improvements! Mostly in regards to Sacrifice. It should work now, and the self-damage message should be more clear. The damage calculator is without a doubt one of the most complex parts of Obsidian Prince, and we're going to be keep tuning it until it's bug-free. If you have any issues with the damage calculator, please keep reporting it to us. It helps us a lot. Thank you! 

Oh, and we added some more faces! Maybe you'll recognize someone in them? :)

notes.title: Balance changes
notes.notes:
Lowered Stormhammer damage by 2.
Lowered Rouge Killstreak damage from 0.5, to 0.33.

notes.title: Patch 0.9 Ouch! Out now
notes.notes:
[b]NEW WEAPON - STORM HAMMER[/b]

Ancient ways have been discovered anew, and the Storm Hammer has been created! Unleash lightning upon your foes. That are wet. Because it's raining!

The Storm Hammer does an area effect damage (3x3), In the middle of the AOE, lightning strikes, electrocuting any water. (You will not take damage from this!) Range 2. Every time you gain energy, the Storm Hammer gains 1 more damage for next your next use. This resets on room change and use.

Inspirations:
Static - [On turn begin] - Gain 1 energy. Do 20% base damage around you.
Lightning Rod - [On turn begin] - Electrocute any puddle you are standing in, doing 20% base damage. You are immune to this damage. If you do not stand on water, gain 1 energy.
Rainstorm - [On turn begin] - Rain pours in a 3x3 area near to you, causing puddles to form.

The hammer can be unlocked in Challenge mode for 500 Obsidian Pennies. The Hammer can be found in the Campaign, but noone has discovered how to build the Storm Hammer crafting house yet

[b]NEW ROOMS[/b]
Mystery rooms have been added to the Challenge Mode. What they are remains largely a mystery (hence the name), however whispers have mentioned treasures protected by ancient traps (be careful  you could end up with grievous wounds) and ancient crystals with long dormant magic now re-awoken. The only way to really find out though is to dive into the dungeons and explore!

(Note mystery rooms will likely make an appearance in campaign mode in the future)

[b]IMPROVED WOUNDS[/b]

The Gods of Emalon have realized that wounds don't really matter that much, and apologise for having too much to do during the days of creation to give them the proper attention.

Wounds are now automatically selected from your backstory deck when they pop up. 

In campaign mode, the Adventurers Guild has decided to set up a nearby Hospital. Here, you can remove a wound, for a minor sum of Glod.

New wound cards are coming soon...

There is also a tutorial for the Hospital.

[b]NEW FOOD[/b]
Bandage Noodles - Chefs (?) have decided to give Doctors a run for their money, and have created a dish that can remove any wound. This can be eaten at a campsite, at your leisure.

Handburgers -  It's summer and the inhabitants of Emalon has started grilling handburgers. Why not grab one to enjoy while dungeon diving?

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]

Fixed an issue where some zombies thought it was Halloween and had dressed up as Candlemages or turned themselves invisible.

Merchants in campaign mode talk a bit less. 

Fixed an issue where the wrong inspiration/backstory deck would show when viewing them through the equipment window. 

Many minor fixes

[b]NOTE FROM THE DEVS[/b]

Now that this patch is out we're going to focus on fixing a couple of bugs especially with the damage calculator and rebalancing resources & Glod further for campaign mode.

notes.title: Get ready for early access 28th of April
notes.notes:
[h1]28th of April Obsidian Prince EA is going live [/h1]

We're super happy to announce that Obsidian Prince is ready for Early Access. 

On the 28th of April we invite you all to jump into campaign mode, play through the first chapter, start unraveling the what's and why's of the Obsidian Prince. Build up the world, tip some cows and discover new dungeons and quests across the world of Emalon. 

In the Early Access, you'll also be able to test your tactical skills in Challenge mode. Delve into a dungeon of ever-increasing difficulty and claim your spot at the top of the high score. 

As we release into Early Access we want to thank all of you who have supported us this far. The feedback and love shown by our community is humbling. 

We're looking forward to feedback from old and new players as we go through Early Access. Your input is helping us polish the game and make it something truly unique. (if you want to give ongoing feedback you're very welcome on our Discord). 

Thank you! And we'll "see" you ingame on the 28th.

notes.title: New Pre Early Access Patch
notes.notes:
[h2]New features:[/h2]

[b]A merchant has moved in[/b]
When exploring Endless mode you'll now sometimes run across a merchant. (because who wouldn't want to set up shop in a dungeon?)
Merchants sell gear, food, potions and allows you to look into the future to change your past. 

[b]Unlocks[/b]
We've implemented the unlock system. All classes, weapons, and potions can now be unlocked with Obsidian Pennies. Your highscore points are automatically translated into Obsidian Pennies that you retain between runs. 


[h2]Changes:[/h2]

Clouds have been updated. They now contain 174% more fluff.

AI will now always take the action that is available when the enemy turn starts. This means archers that were blocked by another enemy on your turn will no longer suddenly shoot you as the blocking enemy moves out of the way. 
This change should make it a lot easier to predict enemy behavior allowing you to plan your moves with more information. 



[h2]Bugfixes:[/h2]

The Illusionist could sometimes spawn instead of the Rat in the Box boss in the tutorial. We've sent him back to his true dimension so the game is a bit fairer to new players. 

Text on Toxic Decay, Honed Acrobacy, Violence, and Adorapples has been fixed to better describe actual effects. 

The color of the flavor text on cards has been updated to make it more readable. 

Multiple bugs with save states have been fixed. Note playing campaign will still overwrite your current Endless Dungeon run so finish your endless dive before booting up the campaign. 
This issue will be fixed before EA. 

A number of other small bugs has been squashed. 


We hope you enjoy the patch :)

Mattias & Sigrid

notes.title: Tossing event rooms into the mix
notes.notes:
Are you ready to meet the newly discovered deities of Emalon? 4 new Gods have made their appearance and disciples have been quick to randomly place altars and places of worship to their newfound divine lords and ladies. 

While exploring the dungeons in Obsidian Prince you'll now have a chance to come across these new shrines. Here you need to decide whether to pay an offering, sacrifice, or potentially desecrate the altar. 

Your choice will build on to your heroes backstory, impacting their abilities in all future. 

Be warned though. Desecrating an altar is dangerous business. Be careful which God you anger. 

[h1]The diety line-up[/h1]

We have a bunch of Gods planned, but here are the ones you'll meet in the patch that just went live. 

[h2]Akavett. Goddess of eye-contact with strangers and awkward silences[/h2]
We've all been there, this Goddess should speak to all of us, but what would we say after discussing the weather ...?
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38340650/8e125f5d82171234f65c04bbefd18b59789591b0.png[/img]

[h2]Pagrax. God of Grammar[/h2]
The obvious worshipping target for everyone who gets ticks from seeing wrongly placed commas. 
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38340650/6b8f95ce7fd5db0e6dc95665d4e4c6bac2b1371b.png[/img]

[h2]Bad God[/h2]
Is this God really bad? Or is it just a case of too much energy?
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38340650/5328e77be29bc64d25b8082f474ac9f807f2495b.png[/img]

[h2]Brad. The God of Bread[/h2]
Married to Bree. The Goddess of Cheese.
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38340650/7d4a98e172b9e26d4e3c736b39e9906dc7bef2e2.png[/img]

[h1]More?[/h1]
In the patch, we've also balanced the difficulty for Endless mode. The dungeons will start out a bit easier, but ramp up the pressure better than before. Now you may want to kill the boss as soon as you find them, or maybe grab a shortcut if you're low on health. On the other hand, every room you clear adds to your hi-score. Choices, choices... 

We hope you enjoy the new content and can't wait to hear your feedback! :)

Sigrid&Mattias

Join us as we (the devs)play Obsidian Prince and chat about why and how we created the game. Whether you want tips on how to best build your characters, want to know why we designed a rat with a bazooka or what made us put tippable cows in the game we're happy to answer.
